meta.title: Services — ACC & Associates
meta.description: Six independent construction consulting services: feasibility & cost planning, programme & delay analysis, contract administration, superintendent, defect & dilapidation, expert witness.

intro.headline: Six services. All independent.
intro.lede: We take on work under a written scope with a fixed fee where the shape of the job allows it. If we are not the right firm — because the matter is too small, out of jurisdiction, or a conflict exists — we say so on the brief call.

items.name: Feasibility & Cost Planning
items.what: A first-principles cost plan built from schematic or DA-stage drawings, with quantities we can defend against a QS at any tier-1 builder. Presented against your budget line-item by line-item, not as a headline number.
items.when: You are about to seek finance, land at auction, or trigger a stage-two commitment, and the number on the page is not one you can hand to a bank yet.
items.deliverable: Written cost plan (BOQ + narrative), risk register, one revision, presentation to your board or lender.

items.name: Programme & Delay Analysis
items.trigger: When the programme starts to slip.
items.what: As-planned vs as-built windows analysis, time impact analysis, or collapsed as-built — whichever the contract and the pleadings call for. AACEI RP-29R-03 methodology, referenced to the actual project documents.
items.when: A contractor has served an EOT claim, a subcontractor is threatening one, or the programme has drifted and you cannot yet see where or why.
items.deliverable: Delay analysis report suitable for negotiation, expert conference, or filing. Native P6 or MS Project files provided.

items.name: Contract Administration
items.what: Full contract administration under AS 4000, AS 4902, AS 2124, GC21, or bespoke forms — RFIs, variations, EOT assessments, progress claims, notices, and correspondence. Impartial where the contract requires it.
items.when: You are the principal or superintendent representative and need the paperwork run by a firm that has been through the same disputes on the other side of the table.
items.deliverable: Ongoing engagement with monthly reporting; complete document register handed over at practical completion.

items.name: Superintendent Services
items.what: Named superintendent under AS 4000 / AS 4902 / AS 2124. Site visits, certifications, EOT determinations, direction to correct, PC certification. Held to the same standard of independence a court would expect.
items.when: You need a superintendent who will hold the middle ground when it costs one party money, and who is prepared to defend a determination in writing.
items.deliverable: Site inspection reports, monthly certificates, determinations, PC and DLP certificates.

items.name: Defect & Dilapidation Reporting
items.what: Pre-construction dilapidation surveys of adjoining property; defect inspection at PC or during DLP; make-good assessment at lease end. Photographed, geolocated, cross-referenced to drawings.
items.when: You are about to start work near a neighbour who will make a claim, taking handover of a building you do not yet trust, or ending a lease under a schedule of condition.
items.deliverable: Illustrated report with defect schedule, rectification scope, and indicative costs where instructed.

items.name: Expert Witness Support
items.trigger: When it is heading to arbitration.
items.what: Independent expert reports and testimony on quantum, delay, defect, or contractual interpretation. Compliant with the Federal Court and NSW/VIC/QLD Supreme Court expert witness codes.
items.when: Proceedings have been filed, or your legal team wants an expert engaged early to shape the pleadings.
items.deliverable: Expert report, joint report with the opposing expert, conclave attendance, and cross-examination as required.
